person_note: The controlling prose is third-person limited, shifting focal attention chiefly between Josie and Alix while retaining the same grammatical person. Numerous event quotes expose sustained external narration and character interiority as “she,” agreeing with Penguin’s authorized opening and the explicit whole-book POV description. First-person and second-person material in the quote set belongs to dialogue, interviews, documentary transcripts, slogans, or promotional paratext. Those embedded media voices are structurally important but do not create sustained first- or second-person base sections, so the multiple perspectives do not warrant ALTERNATING. The main limitation is that the strongest authorized prose extract covers the opening, but the broader structural sources and distributed quote evidence resolve that scope limitation.
